description: Common Stage 3 prediction contract shared by the Winter et al. (2020) baseline and the Sun et al. (2024) method-level independent reconstruction (S3.4 / S3.5). Every runner emits one JSON object per line with these fields; the common evaluator (scripts/evaluate_stage3_common.py) consumes them against the frozen S3.2/S3.3 correction pack. Runners are gold-blind: they read only the blank pack (candidates + rule_text, no decisions).

matching_score.description: continuous relevance score; Winter=fitness, Sun=Definition 4 matching score

predicted_relevance.description: null means ranking-only (Sun primary); binary only with a pre-registered rule

incorrect_actor_score.description: Winter=cost_resource; Sun=Definition 6 actor violation; null/NaN when unobservable

threshold.description: primary threshold used for the binary decision (tau/gamma/theta)

source_hashes.description: rule-record source and process-record source hashes used for this prediction
